bootstrap.head: increment/8-ci-baseline
bootstrap.reason: Preserve the independently validated Increment 1-8 commit history while establishing the protected trunk.
bootstrap.after_bootstrap: Create each increment branch from current main and squash-merge only after Core CI passes.

dev_branch.reason: A long-lived dev branch would duplicate integration state and delay default-branch CI and scheduled dependency reporting.
dev_branch.future_gate: Introduce only through an accepted ADR if concurrent release trains require it.
